# Retail CoD United Offensive 1.51b dedicated server: the bones of a walking player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_legs), one client joined allies with the
# m1carbine_mp, its spawn forced onto the deathmatch point at (720, -32), the one -legs-uo.txt's
# probe took. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 8 s later:
#   COD_DIR=<UO install, 1.5 main/ and uo/> COD_VERSION=uo PORT=34562 PROBE_SECS=80 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_legs mp_carentan +set probe_legs_spawn 720_-32
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <same> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:34562 \
#       --probe-team allies --save-legs --probe-secs 70 --capture-tag uo-spawn720
# The 1.1d capture's layout (-legs.txt); the client half is -legs-client-uo-spawn720.txt,
# which logs the join's snapshots and cmds too (!psnap, !pcmd).
# docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 15, "The spawn idle on 1.5 and UO", is what it measured.
